title: You contract precedence metadata
description: Family-neutral file, environment, and flag precedence metadata for one contract setting. Precedence metadata documents override layers; it does not model env or flag values as JSON document properties.

formatVersion.description: The explicitly supported version of this precedence metadata format.

layers.description: Ordered override layers from lowest to highest precedence for this setting.

environmentVariable.description: Environment variable name for the env layer when present.

flagName.description: CLI flag name for the flag layer when present.

layer.description: One precedence layer in ascending override order.
